name: voice-brief
description: Speaks one short <say> line per assistant message through a local streaming TTS daemon.

engine.title: TTS engine
engine.description: mlx streams PCM from a local HTTP server; system falls back to macOS say.

ttsUrl.title: Local TTS base URL
ttsUrl.description: Base URL of the mlx-audio server.

sampleRate.title: PCM sample rate
sampleRate.description: Sample rate of the engine's raw PCM output; must match the server.

refAudio.title: Reference wav
refAudio.description: none uses the bundled stable voice, or an absolute path to your own wav to clone.

refText.title: Reference transcript
refText.description: Transcript of your reference wav. The bundled voice carries its own, so leave it as none unless you clone.

autostart.title: Start TTS server
autostart.description: Start the local mlx-audio server on session start when it is not running (1) or leave it alone (0).

modelPreset.title: Model preset
modelPreset.description: Qwen3-TTS base model; both are cloning models.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: auto follows the language of your messages. Used for notification phrases and for the synthesis language code.

announceProject.title: Announce the project
announceProject.description: Prefix a phrase with the project name when a different session speaks. 1 on, 0 off.
